Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. - update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. - fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-86`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` (implemented in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`). This does a single goldmark AST walk over the memo's Markdown content and writes the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (the `storepb.MemoPayload` / `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` structs defined in `proto/store/memo.proto:7-29`).

**Triggers (recomputation call sites):**
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, run once when a new memo is created.
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:435-449`, but only when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e., only re-extracted when the memo's content is actually being changed, not on other field updates like visibility/pin).
- A backfill/maintenance runner — `Runner.RunOnce()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`, which batches through *all* memos (100 at a time) and rebuilds+persists every memo's payload; used to backfill/repair derived metadata outside the normal create/update flow (e.g., migrations or admin-triggered rebuild).

**Extracted properties** (from `ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:362-421`, matching `MemoPayload.Property` in `proto/store/memo.proto:15-22`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` nodes found in the content (deduplicated, case preserved) — `MemoPayload.tags`
- `Property.Title` — text of the first H1 heading, only if it's the very first block-level node in the document
- `Property.HasLink` — true if any Markdown link node is present
- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block, fenced code block, or inline code span is present
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox is present
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked
- (also collects `Mentions` — usernames from `@mention` nodes — into the in-memory `ExtractedData`, though only `Tags`/`Property` are persisted into `memo.Payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload`)

## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** repo (Go backend in `internal/`, `server/`, `store/`; React frontend in `web/`). Memo content is Markdown, and derived/computed metadata (as opposed to user-set fields like `visibility`, `pinned`) is extracted from that Markdown on the backend, stored in a `payload` protobuf blob on the memo row, and served to the frontend for list/preview/filter use.

### 1. Where the derived metadata is computed

- **Extraction logic (the actual parsing/derivation):** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
  - `func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` — lines 356–422. Single-pass goldmark AST walk that derives tags, mentions, and the `Property` struct (title/hasLink/hasCode/hasTaskList/hasIncompleteTasks).
  - `func (s *service) ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)` — lines 193–241 (an older/alternate single-purpose version of the same logic).
  - `func (s *service) ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)` — lines 143–170.
  - `func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` — lines 264–346. Walks the AST, strips code blocks, concatenates text/heading/list/table text, and truncates at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 472–489) to build a plain-text preview snippet.

- **Orchestration / write-back into the memo's payload:** `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
  - `func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error` — lines 74–88. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(...)` and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property = data.Property`.
  - `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)` — lines 27–72. A batch job that re-runs `RebuildMemoPayload` over **all** memos in the store and persists them via `Store.UpdateMemo`. (Defined but not wired into any scheduler/cmd in this codebase — it's available as a one-off backfill/repair runner, e.g. after markdown-parsing logic changes.)

- **Snippet generation for API responses:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89` — `getMemoContentSnippet(content string)` calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)` (max length 64 chars), used when building `v1pb.Memo` responses.

### 2. What triggers recomputation

There's no ORM-style pre-save hook/middleware; it's explicit function calls at the API-handler layer (not in `store/memo.go`'s DB access code):

- **On memo create:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` inside `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` is called before `s.Store.CreateMemo(...)`.
- **On memo content update:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` inside `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo`, but **only when `content` is in the update mask** (line 434 `if path == "content"`) — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` runs, then `update.Payload = memo.Payload` is persisted. (Updating other fields like visibility/pinned does not trigger recomputation.)
- **On tag rename:** `RenameTag` in `markdown.go:425` rewrites content in place; callers presumably re-run `RebuildMemoPayload` afterward (tags/properties are re-derived because content changed).
- **On-demand snippet generation for responses:** every time a memo is serialized to the API response / notification / relation payload — `getMemoContentSnippet` is called fresh from `memo.Content` (not cached) at:
  - `memo_service_converter.go:76` (`convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`, single memo → snippet field on every returned `v1pb.Memo`)
  - `memo_service_converter.go:225` and `:248` (batch relation conversion, only when `includeSnippets` is true)
  - `memo_relation_service.go:154` and `:162` (memo relation snippet, for both source and related memo)
  - `user_service_notifications.go:323` (notification snippet)
  - So: snippet is a computed-on-read field, never stored; title/tags/hasLink/hasCode/hasTaskList/hasIncompleteTasks are computed-on-write and stored in `memo.Payload`.
- **Bulk backfill:** `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`runner.go:27`) recomputes payload for every memo in batches of 100 — intended to be invoked as a maintenance/migration operation.

### 3. What properties are derived

Defined in `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95` (`MemoPayload_Property`, generated from `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` message `MemoPayload.Property`):

- `Title` (string) — extracted from the first H1 heading if the document's first block is an `H1` (`markdown.go:207-213` / `383-389`, via `extractHeadingText`).
- `HasLink` (bool) — true if any Markdown link node exists (`markdown.go:216-217` / `393-394`).
- `HasCode` (bool) — true if any code block, fenced code block, or inline code span exists (`markdown.go:219-220` / `396-397`).
- `HasTaskList` (bool) — true if any task checkbox (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) exists (`markdown.go:222-223` / `399-400`).
- `HasIncompleteTasks` (bool) — true if any unchecked task checkbox exists (`markdown.go:224-227` / `401-404`).
- `Tags` ([]string) — all `#tag` occurrences, deduplicated preserving case, excluding tags inside links/images (`markdown.go:142-170`, `uniquePreserveCase` at `455-468`).
- `Mentions` ([]string, part of `ExtractedData`, not persisted onto `MemoPayload` directly but used elsewhere for `@mention` notifications) — lowercased, deduplicated (`markdown.go:379-381`).
- `Snippet` (string, on the outgoing `v1pb.Memo`/`v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo` proto, **not stored** — computed fresh per response) — plain-text preview capped at 64 chars, code blocks skipped, truncated at word boundary with `" ..."` suffix (`markdown.go:264-346`; called via `getMemoContentSnippet`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`).

No word count / reading time field exists in this codebase — the only content-derived preview metrics found are `snippet`, `title`, and the four boolean content-shape flags (`hasLink`, `hasCode`, `hasTaskList`, `hasIncompleteTasks`), plus `tags`.

### Frontend consumption (read-only, not recomputation)

These derived fields flow to the React app purely as data on the `Memo`/`MemoRelation_Memo` proto message (`/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:186-190, 619-623`) and are used for:
- Filtering by content shape: `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts`, `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoFilters.tsx`, `/bench/repo/web/src/contexts/MemoFilterContext.tsx` (filters like "has link", "has code", "has incomplete tasks").
- Preview/snippet display in relation links and map markers: `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoSnippetLink.tsx`, `/bench/repo/web/src/components/UserMemoMap/UserMemoMap.tsx:154`, `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoDetailSidebar/MemoDetailSidebar.tsx:91-155`, `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoMetadata/Relation/*`.

The frontend does not recompute this metadata itself — it is entirely a backend responsibility (Go, goldmark-based Markdown AST walk).</result>
